games.title: Armored Core
games.description: The original Raven contract. Classic digital controls; analog modifications are optional.

games.title: Armored Core: Project Phantasma
games.description: A first-generation expansion with compatible original-game save import.

games.title: Armored Core: Master of Arena
games.description: Two-disc arena and campaign collection. Register each disc separately.

games.title: Armored Core 2
games.description: The series moves to PlayStation 2. Keep automatic game fixes enabled.

games.title: Armored Core 2: Another Age
games.description: A mission-focused follow-up with Armored Core 2 save carryover.

games.title: Armored Core 3
games.description: The layered world of the third generation. PS2 and Portable remain distinct editions.

games.title: Silent Line: Armored Core
games.description: A separate campaign that supports importing Armored Core 3 data.

games.title: Armored Core: Nexus
games.description: Evolution and Revolution are separate discs. Native dual-stick controls.

games.title: Armored Core: Nine Breaker
games.description: A training and arena release. Keep its own edition and configuration.

games.title: Armored Core: Formula Front
games.description: PS2 and PSP variants differ. Choose the release you own; do not substitute platforms.

games.title: Armored Core: Last Raven
games.description: The final PS2 campaign. Scaling can affect post-processing; Original is the default.

games.title: Armored Core 4
games.description: PS3 and Xbox 360 are independent options. Regulations and updates change balance.

games.title: Armored Core: For Answer
games.description: Fast fourth-generation combat. Preserve both console editions and independent build selections.

games.title: Armored Core V
games.description: Experimental emulation support. Do not assume campaign completion or online availability.

games.title: Armored Core: Verdict Day
games.description: Experimental emulation support with documented rendering issues.
